title: Owner-Builder Permit
summary: This page provides information about the Owner-Builder Permit process for building or renovating a property in NSW.
who_can_apply: You must be the owner of the property where the work is being done.
You must comply with all relevant building codes and regulations.
what_you_need: Detailed plans and specifications for the work.
A qualified builder or contractor to manage the construction process.

internal_links.text: Change the details on an Owner-Builder Permit

faqs.a: An Owner-Builder Permit allows you to manage and oversee the building or renovation of your own property, provided you meet specific requirements.

faqs.q: How do I apply for an Owner-Builder Permit?
faqs.a: You can apply for an Owner-Builder Permit using the dedicated transaction page.

faqs.q: What if I need to change or cancel my permit?
faqs.a: You can change the details or cancel your permit using the relevant transaction pages.
